core_message: An 'empty' street at 3 AM is busy; it is just working for somebody else: the bakers, the bin crew and a fox.
audience_note: People who have walked home late and photographers curious about night work; no technical background needed.

plans.hook: For six weeks I photographed one street between 2 AM and 4 AM.
beats: Set-up: 400 metres of Kettle Lane, one 35mm lens, no flash, every night for six weeks
3:40 AM the bins go out and the street is loud for eleven minutes
A fox near number 27 on 31 of 42 nights; 9 people walked the whole street
The argument: empty streets are working for somebody else
plans.cta: What does your street do while you sleep?

Only 9 people walked the full length of the street in six weeks
One camera, one 35mm lens, no flash, no tripod
The street is working for somebody else: the bakers, the bin crew, the fox
